verses.1: Perceiving the portents, Rama spoke these words embracing Saumithri who was aware of the portents.
verses.2: "Lakshmana Arrange a place in this forest where there is cool water and fruits for the battalions of the army, we shall remain (alert)."
verses.3: "Dreadful warriors, Bears, monkeys, and Rakshasas will be slain, and I foresee that which bodes destruction of people."
verses.4: "The wind is blowing mixed with dust, even the earth is cracking, mountain tops are shaking, and huge trees are breaking and falling down."
verses.5: "Clouds resembling raw flesh in colour, are making harsh frightening sounds, and rain mixed with drops of blood."
verses.6: "The twilight in red sandal colour is very frightening. The Sun is blazing, raining masses of fire in variegated colours."
verses.7: "The wild animals all over have a piteous look and wailing in low tone standing opposite the Sun is indicating fear."
verses.8: "The moon devoid of glow even in the night is like the Sun with black rays around and red aura behind (the black)."
verses.9: "Lakshmana the white Sun is appearing in copper colour around with black colour in the centre which had not been seen before. It is small and dreary."
verses.10: "Lakshmana the stars devoid of brightness are indicating as though it is the time of dissolution of the universe?"
verses.11: "The crows, hawks and eagles are falling down like small animals. Also, the jackals are creating fear by making howls."
verses.12: "The earth will turn into a mass of flesh and blood and will be covered by the mountains and tridents hurled by Vanaras and Rakshasas."
verses.13: All the Vanaras turning their direction will go immediately and now itself, swiftly to the city ruled by Ravana (said Rama to Lakshmana).
verses.14: Rama, the subduer of enemies in war, a celebrated one having spoken this way proceeded towards Lanka going in front wielding a bow.
verses.15: Then Vibheeshana, Sugriva and all bulls among Vanaras determined in the matter of slaying (the enemies) went roaring.
verses.16: To make Rama happy, the excessively heroic Vanaras made monkey actions. Seeing that Rama felt happy. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेत्रयोविंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twenty third sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
